description.zh-CN: 世界卫生组织五项身心健康指标（WHO-5），用 5 个正面描述了解过去两周的主观幸福感。分数越高表示状态越好。
description.en: The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index: five positively worded statements about the last two weeks. Higher scores mean better well-being.

instructions.zh-CN: 请在下面五个句子的每个句子（表述）中标出在过去两星期里你最接近感觉状态。请注意数字越大表明你的身心越健康。例如：如果你在过去两星期里有一半以上时间感到快乐、心情舒畅，就请选择“超过一半的时间”（3）。
instructions.en: Please indicate for each of the five statements which is closest to how you have been feeling over the last two weeks. Notice that higher numbers mean better well-being. Example: if you have felt cheerful and in good spirits more than half of the time during the last two weeks, select number three.

label.en: More than half of the time
Less than half of the time

text.en: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed

text.zh-CN: 我感觉充满活力、精力充沛
text.en: I have felt active and vigorous

text.zh-CN: 我睡醒时感到清新、得到了足够休息
text.en: I woke up feeling fresh and rested

text.zh-CN: 我每天生活充满了有趣的事情
text.en: My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

summary.zh-CN: 百分制得分低于 50。WHO 说明指出，低于 50 分提示近期身心状态较差，建议进一步评估是否存在需要关注的心理健康问题（例如抑郁）。
summary.en: Percentage score below 50. WHO notes that a score below 50 suggests poor mental well-being and is an indication for further assessment (for example for depression).

suggestions.zh-CN: 可以再完成一次 PHQ-9 抑郁症状自评，或和专业人士聊聊最近的状态。
suggestions.en: Consider also taking the PHQ-9 check-in, or talk with a professional about how you have been.

suggestions.zh-CN: 回顾一下最近的睡眠、压力和生活变化，看看哪些方面可以先做一点调整。
suggestions.en: Look at recent sleep, stress and life changes to see where a small adjustment could start.
Share how you feel with someone you trust.

label.en: At or above the reference line

summary.zh-CN: 百分制得分不低于 50，没有达到 WHO 建议进一步评估的参考线。分数越高，表示过去两周的主观幸福感越好。
summary.en: Percentage score of 50 or more, above the line WHO suggests for further assessment. Higher scores mean better well-being over the last two weeks.

suggestions.zh-CN: 留意哪些事情让你感到愉快和有活力，并为它们留出时间。
suggestions.en: Notice what makes you feel good and energetic, and keep time for it.

suggestions.zh-CN: 定期自评可以帮助你看到自己的变化；原中文版说明指出百分制相差 10 分可视为明显变化。
suggestions.en: Regular check-ins show how you change over time; the Chinese version notes that a 10-point difference on the percentage scale indicates a meaningful change.
